svg.text: One Durable Object EveriseDb (SQLite-backed key-value storage) used as a NoSQL document store: the app's 8 collections, no fixed schema (the cached FFXIV data is in the README).
Each document is one key-value entry:
added by the store to every document.
• Queries scan a collection's key prefix and
• Tags and favorites have no collection: they
are arrays inside each article document.
• Requests are serialized: no write races.

g.text: document id, also the key suffix
References are not enforced by the database.
